fh6_ui_structure_pass.method: 4 parallel research agents restricted to FH6-only sources (dated >= 2026-05-19 AND explicitly naming FH6), seeded by the PRIMARY in-game Alignment screenshot. Each agent reported per-source FH6-verification basis; the parent vetted provenance before codifying into tuning-variables.json v2.0.
rejected: forzatune.com fully-updated guide (mixes FH6 + FM2023 + older; numeric FH5-tagged claims excluded).
apexspeedcraft original post (2026-04-25 pre-release) — only its post-launch update used, for corroboration.
fh6_ui_structure_pass.confirmed_structure: 9 tabs (Tires, Gearing, Alignment, Antiroll Bars, Springs, Damping, Aero, Brake, Differential); no separate Ride Height tab (it is in Springs); ARB 1-65; damping = Bump+Rebound per axle; AWD diff = Front/Rear/Center; center balance = '30/70 split'; aero sliders part-gated; Aero Balance ~0.40-0.50 is a new FH6 target.
fh6_ui_structure_pass.needs_ingame_capture: Literal pole-label TEXT on most tabs, and numeric min/max on Gearing/Springs/RideHeight/Damping/Aero/Brake-pressure/Diff. The 'damping 1-20' scale and 'aero lbf' unit are FH5 carryovers, NOT FH6-verified. One screenshot per tab would close these gaps.

fh6_ui_screenshot_pass.source: in-game-recording (20s mp4 of all 9 tabs, 2014 Golf R PI 589)
fh6_ui_screenshot_pass.result: ALL 9 tab structures upgraded from web-researched to PRIMARY screenshot-verified in tuning-variables.json v2.1. Section names, slider lists, pole labels, displayed units, and lock banners are now confirmed.
corrections_vs_web_research: Aero downforce poles are 'Speed <-> Cornering' (web guessed 'less/more').
Brake balance poles are 'Rear <-> Front' (left=Rear, right=Front).
Gearing poles are 'Speed <-> Acceleration'; observed car is 6-speed.
Springs unit confirmed LB/IN, Ride Height IN, Tire pressure PSI (US locale).
Damping 'Soft <-> Stiff' confirmed; the FH5 '1-20' scale label was never shown (values are unitless one-decimal).
Locked tabs render as padlock icons + a yellow 'UNLOCKED BY INSTALLING <PART>' banner — NOT 'N/A'.
fh6_ui_screenshot_pass.still_open: Only ABSOLUTE slider min/max end-stops remain unverified (the menu never prints them); these stay as franchise-convention estimates.

verification_pass.method: 3 independent research agents cross-checked every v1/v2 claim against forums + independent databases, weighted for source independence.
verification_pass.headline: Most QUALITATIVE claims held up (AWD meta, grip-before-power, starter cars, free GT-R path, share codes exist). Several NUMERIC claims were wrong or fabricated and have been corrected or downgraded.
corrections: AFK farm rate ~2,300 cr/lap -> ~140k cr/lap (~900k-1M/hr); car = Tacoma FE only.
Festival Playlist '40/50/80%' -> points system (20/40/80 PTS) per official forums.
Assist multiplier %s (+15/+15/+10/+10) downgraded to CONTESTED — likely SEO-fabricated; AI difficulty is the real lever.
Diff baseline 55%/15% downgraded to CONTESTED — sources give 100%/45% or 50-70%/10-15%.
'30/70 power split' clarified as the diff CENTER BALANCE, not a separate slider.
Drag share codes 113601876/109333743 retracted (unverifiable); real code 514752751.
22B 'best A-class rally' downgraded to probable (single-origin SEO).
Gemera flagged Car Pass (paid DLC); AMG One often free via FH5 save; best CC car is 1999 Viper GTS ACR FE (VIP).
Photo trick clarified: Festival/Promo XP (not player level), two presses not a chord.
